released.fact: Abishai's victim changes from Ishbi-benob to Saph. At higher doses the text says wounded rather than killed.
Micah addresses the parent who cursed. Both references change from mother to father.
After leaving the same camp, the party enters the hill country of Judah in place of Ephraim.
The man consulted and the man answering are called a prophet in the edited window and a priest in the clean one.
